title: 跑
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L174 跑. Latest origin/main at production start is complete through L172 快; L174 depends on not-yet-merged L173 事 before production JSON may merge. Provisional learned chars from the handoff are 事. Do not merge production JSON, planner-data, or ledger until L173 is present in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 想, 情, 服, 見, 完, 乾, 淨, 忙, 急, 進, 步, 馬, 才, 剛, 弄, 修, 丟, 收, or 拾. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using L058 style anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.
